data: Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.
Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter is a deep-space orbiter built by Lockheed Martin in USA. Highest-resolution Mars imaging from orbit. In service since 2005.
First Mercury orbiter — 6 planetary gravity assists over 6.6 years to bleed energy before insertion in 2011
Only spacecraft to orbit two extraterrestrial worlds — Vesta then Ceres via ion propulsion
NASA's active lunar recon orbiter. LROC's 0.5 m/pixel imagery is the source of every Apollo + Luna + Chang'e landing-site photo here
Longest-lived Mars asset ever — orbiting since 2001-10-24. Gamma-ray + neutron water-ice maps; UHF relay for the surface fleet
NASA Discovery polar orbiter — neutron-spectrometer hydrogen finding at both poles 1998; deliberate Shoemaker impact ended mission 1999

MRO's HiRISE camera has a pixel scale of 25 cm — sharp enough to find Beagle 2's wreckage in 2015 and to image Curiosity and Perseverance from orbit. Acts as the primary high-bandwidth relay for surface assets.
